To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the use of patient-reported outcome (PRO) measures is a promising approach to assessing the effectiveness of cancer treatments; (b) PROs can be integrated into clinical practice and research; (c) PROs can improve patient care and outcomes; and (d) PROs have the potential to improve the efficiency of clinical research and health care delivery.
The use of patient-reported outcomes (PROs) is a feasible and valuable approach to assess treatment effects in clinical trials in advanced melanoma.
